messages:
Ana: Quick design question  should the default spend timeline be Monthly calendar buckets or a Rolling 30-day view? Also prototyping an "auto-collapse" for projects under $5/mo to reduce noise. Thoughts?
Devon: Monthly is familiar for finance + invoice alignment. Rolling 30d is better for ops (recent trends). We could let users pick and remember preference.
Ravi: From CS calls, startups ask for rolling 30d; enterprises want month-aligned invoices. Maybe default per-org: if org has >10 seats default to Monthly, else 30d.
Sasha: Technical: rolling windows need more realtime aggregation. Monthly can be served from precomputed month buckets. Auto-collapse: backend can mark low-cost projects and UI can collapse by default with a "Show all" row.
Matt: UX: when collapsed show a tiny summary line: "12 projects collapsed — showing top 5 by spend" with a clear CTA. For invoices, primary CTA remains "Save as PDF"; secondary "Export CSV".
Jordan: Telemetry: track billing.view.window (monthly|30d), billing.projects.collapsed_count, billing.preferred_window.set. Also track when users opt into always-show-low-cost-projects.
Ana: Accessibility nit: collapsed groups need proper region labels and a skip link so keyboard users can jump to full list. Also token pills: current color combos fail AA for small labels.
Sasha: Implementation notes: add endpoint GET /billing/{org}/summary?window=30d|month and flag low_cost=true for projects < threshold. Lazy-load collapsed items on click. Use ETag for cached month buckets.
Devon: PDF behavior: PDFs should be month-aligned if user chooses monthly. If rolling 30d is selected, PDF should include an explicit header "Rolling 30-day period: YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD". Legal confirmed footer must always be present in PDF.
Matt: Visual: add a small "anomaly" badge for rows with unusual spend spikes (orange dot) and a tooltip "Spend anomaly: investigate". Also micro-sparklines per project helpful.
Ravi: For the auto-collapse threshold, propose default $5/mo but let billing admins override per-org. Also add an affordance to pin a project so it's never collapsed.
Ana: Copy tweak: collapsed summary text -> "Hidden low-cost projects (click to expand)" and aria-expanded on the control.
Jordan: I'll add events: billing.collapse.toggle, billing.project.pin, billing.window.change.
Sasha: We'll return counts and a sample set in the summary payload so UI can show top N without extra calls. Example: {"top_projects":[],"collapsed_count":12} (returned as JSON).
Devon: Mobile: collapse is essential. Show top 3 projects then a prominent "Show X more" button that opens a drawer list. Avoid dense tables.
Ana: Action items: I'll add monthly + 30d frames, collapsed state + pin affordance, anomaly badge. Sasha to spec new summary endpoint and lazy-load, Jordan to add telemetry, Matt to finalise CTAs/copy, Devon to validate PDF header and footer behavior.
